column6: Loss of the nominative-singular marker *-z after stem-final consonant in athematic (root-noun/consonant-stem) nominatives (*bōkz > *bōk, *gánsz > *gáns, *lūsz > *lūs, *fláuxz > *fláux); morphological/analogical elimination complete before Proto-West Germanic.
column12: New rule 2026 from the SC020 three-rule split (Dossier A sc020-dossier-a-root-noun-nominative-z.md; adjudication memo). Primarily a morphological development (endingless nominative generalized in the consonant-stem paradigm); the Foma environment (monosyllabic -Cz#) is a proxy stated over the corpus domain. Composed at the head of EnglishProtoToOE, before PWGmcIjContraction, so contraction-created monosyllables (friend *fríundz) never reach it. Identifier RootNounNomZLoss is a working placeholder pending global rename. Scope: WGmc absolute; NGmc conditional (see dossier).

column6: Later northern West Germanic loss of word-final *-z in stressed monosyllables, with compensatory lengthening of a short nucleus (*maiz > OE mā, *hwaz > hwā, *kūz > cū); OHG instead rhotacizes (ir, wir, mēr). Corpus witness: who (*xwaz > OE hwa).
column12: New rule 2026 from the SC020 three-rule split (Dossier C sc020-dossier-c-northern-monosyllable-final-z.md; adjudication memo). Genuine historical change (R/T 2014 pp.86-87; Fulk 2018; Crist 2002) now corpus-witnessed by who (*xwaz > OE hwa; corpus-maturation pass 2026) in addition to the synthetic unit examples. Must stay after the SC018/SC019 o-raisers (premature z-loss would expose English-doculect *-oz forms to raising). Identifier MonosyllabicFinalZLoss is a working placeholder pending global rename. Conditioning (quality-neutral vs front-vowel) analysis-dependent, see Dossier C §3.

column6: Proto-West Germanic apocope of word-final short high vowels after heavy syllables in unstressed words (*iwwi > *iww beside stressed *iuwi); OE eow continues the unstressed sentence variant, as its lack of i-umlaut proves.
column12: New rule 2026 (corpus-maturation pass; dossier sc098-dossier-unstressed-word-final-i-apocope.md). Exceptionless prosodically conditioned law (R/T 2014: 57-58); apparent exceptions are proclitics outside the environment (R/T's own account). Licenses PWGmc *iuwi ~ *iuw (R/T 2014: 41-42). Fed by SC020 (z-loss makes *-i final); bleeds SC055 i-umlaut (dating evidence). Proxy environment over the SC008 geminate *ww domain, exactly coextensive with the law's unstressed-word corpus domain (cf. SC096 proxy convention). Composed after EAFFinalZDeletion, before MonosyllabicFinalZLoss.
